matrix: 5 recipes x 2 chunkers x 3 sizes = 30 per dataset

execution.quality_retry_policy: failed first attempts block automatic selection

selection.coverage: packed-context evidence; equal dataset weight; Dense/Hybrid and all three sizes
selection.indexing_cost: chunking + BM25 build + corpus embedding + FAISS build + persistence

resume_invariants: same configuration, data, models, source fingerprint, environment and limits
append-only hash chain; consecutive attempts; no request after success
partial or corrupt tails preserved and rejected, never silently repaired
max-requests is a stop control, not an experiment change

reporting.timing: successful first attempts; retries and failures counted separately
reporting.uncertainty: 500 question-cluster bootstrap resamples; no interval with one question

tests: local ignored tests are optional validation aids; normal commands never depend on them
